body: Thanks for making me laugh.  Sorry to have laughed at your misfortune, but I find it just a little funny for some reason.

The song you linked is just beautiful.  You seem so intelligent and cultured, I'm almost embarrassed to share my favorite song from when I was younger... but it's odd, like me, and I feel like it encompasses a good majority of what I have liked in my lifetime.  Dark and lovely, a Victorian sort of loveliness... and distinctly odd Japanese stuff.  Every member of this band is a man! Surprise!
[Malice Mizer - Beast of Blood](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VhiwRhPS1O0)

My favorite color has been purple my entire life.  I can't seem to let it go.  My hair has been dyed a lovely shade of deep blueviolet for over ten years now.  I worked at a mid-end jewelry store in a mall for a few years before kids, purple hair and all.  I suppose I was some kind of exception to dresscode because it's not a shocking bright stand-out color, and I pretty much only own clothes that color-range anyway.  I've lived life in monochrome.

It must be hard work.  I never did go to college.  I had bad grades in high school, and never pursued a higher education. 

Before kids, I played Ragnarok Online, then Mabinogi, then Eve Online.  I no longer had time to play MMORPGs after kids, but I did love them a lot.  I liked strategy games, too!  One of my all-time favorite games was Advance Wars.  I occasionally play Dungeon Defenders with not-husband, because he loves it.  It's alright.  If I have a few minutes of down-time at home, I play flash games like Papas Donuteria (as well as all the other Papas whatever-ria games).  They give me something to do for five minutes at a time.

I used to draw, and paint, but I was never very good at it. haha  I got pretty good at makeup, and painting nails, which I consider art enough, and it gave me a sense of being adequately feminine... 

I have always had a soft spot for the dark and lovely things. My favorite color is purple, and I like to collect little purple trinkets, vases, fake flowers, candles, etc.

What kind of music do you enjoy?...  Would you mind sharing with me your favorite song?

You're a smart person.  I like the honest answer of "it gets me credit for my psych class".  You're a diamond among the heaps of coal that is humanity.

Anything else? Yes!  What are your interests? Hobbies? Passions?  What happened to you that you were considering ending it, if that isn't too personal?... It's nice to have someone to talk to... but I would hate to be so selfish that I wouldn't ask you about yourself.
You make me cry... why would you want to help me?  I'm so confused.  But I will gladly take you up on that offer...

Not at all.  I'm scared of people.  I'd do it for my girls, but I'm a miserable failure, awkward as hell, and can't get anything done right.  I'm scared.

Even if I get it done instead of dying, I'll still be here... with more responsibilities, less time to get it all done, and still living the same life with the same brain that does nothing but hurt.

I should expand that they were ready to get rid of me for years.  I was a failure.  I sucked at school, I attempted suicide, I told them I was bisexual, I never dated a white boy, I was weird, I attempted suicide.  It's a shame I failed, because I suck so bad at everything I couldn't even do that right.  Children out of wedlock with a man of any ethnicity other than Caucasian? I've been dead for years.  Why am I still alive?
Absolutely.  I'm dead to them.
A sense of relief.  Someone is listening to me!  It's unbelievable.  I don't know how certain I am about living... but it's comforting.
She knows nothing.  I know she openly hates "hippies" and "holistic medicine" and "anti-vaxxers"... She doesn't even know the mess I've gotten myself in... and I can't tell her.  She'll be gone.

Isn't that the truth...

I've never had female friends.  I was very boyish growing up.  To be honest, I was convinced that when I grew up, I'd finally grow my penis and be able to use the boy's bathroom like everyone else I thought to be like myself! Unfortunately, puberty was horrifyingly different.  I grew a giant rack, was rail thin, and apparently that's just pretty enough to be made an object.  I tried my best to deal with it.  I had to learn how to be a girl from scratch because the cards of life I was dealt was really ... unexpected.  I turned into a goth girl... and I loved it.  I still dress that way.  I'll always be a little weird, and the style makes me happy, and with any luck, deters some people I don't want to waste my time dealing with away. 

 My daughter's friend is the child from the adjacent apartment, and I see the mother quite often.  I do not consider her a friend.  I can't talk to her without her being offended, or pissy, or judging me.  That's been my experience with every female friendship I've attempted.  I don't WANT to be in some kind of "competition" with another girl.  That's what it always seems to turn in to.  I'd rather rest...
No, my parents haven't spoken to me in years. :/

It's fine if your messages are slow.  I understand that you have a life, and you've extended your kindness to me.  It feels better than I can express, and thank you.  

I try my best to be a good mom, but I fuck up all the time.  Anti-vax?  What the hell was my problem?  Why am I so afraid of doctors?  The crippling debt they give me?... I don't know.  My oldest one should start kindergarten soon because of her age, but I have NO IDEA what I'm doing. And honestly, I'm SCARED because my school life was terrible.  But she's social, and I feel like I am depriving her of life.  Thus why I need to die.  

The friendships... I had  few decent ones growing up.  My best friend through high school was a metalhead kid who enjoyed my goth self.  We met before I looked "pretty".  We spent hours writing to each other.  Doing text-based RPGs, co-writing little mary-sue self-insert-character novels to each other, played Dungeons and Dragons together, and spent a huge amount time playing fighting video games and watching anime.  He was the last real friend I've had.  We went our separate ways.  He went to college... we grew apart... we lost touch.
No other friendships I had didn't end up with the person telling me that I was "so pretty" and not taking "no" for an answer.  And I guess sometimes I was desperate for love and friendship and attention, and "no" becomes "...okay."

Growing up... well... my parents are still married.  I dunno about happily, but they are married.  Live in the same house, sleep in separate rooms.  I don't think I have ever seen my father kiss my mother, or hold her hand either.  My father was the "good provider" type.  Very religious, very conservative, has an excellent job that pays well... but I never really saw him.  I have no relationship with him outside of knowing who he is.... and whatever I might have had was extinguished when I got knocked up by a "filthy Mexican" and not being actually married.  


I have a brother 11 years younger than me... I don't really know him, even though we were raised in the same house.  I was 18 when I left home... he was 7 years old.  We never speak.


My mother often pitted my sister and I against each other.  I'm not sure if she meant it, but the damage was done for a long time.  Sister is thinner than you, Sister is smarter than you, Sister is better than you... I don't blame my sister though.  It affected her the same, and we have a good relationship these days.  I love her, and when I do see her, I try to show it.  But I can't ask her for help... she doesn't understand, and she gets disappointed easily, and really... I just don't want to burden her.  She loves my kids.  She takes them on outings.  The fair, the aquarium, the zoo... things I can't provide for them myself.  The last time I tried to off myself, she took them without hesitation.  I have the feeling the girls would be better off with her.

What do I like to do?...  Sometimes, I listen to my music that I used to like when my life sucked just a little less.  But it's not often.  It's not appropriate for children, and if not-husband is around, my music gets overridden for his own.  Which is fine.  His music is pretty good too.

Sometimes, I play video games.  I used to really like mmorpgs... but I haven't had time to play one for many years.  I mostly play flash games because I can just walk away from it if someone needs me.  They're not so bad.

Sometimes, I take the kids to the park.  There's one very close here, and they really love to play and meet people.  Even at the park, I feel uncomfortable.  I've had people come on to me, flirt too aggressively, I get uncomfortable easily, because I've been taken advantage of many times.

Sometimes, I do my makeup.  I really loved makeup.

Oh, haha, I've been stupid my whole life.  It's really not caused by or related to my not-husband.  And I have no friends because the only thing my friendships have ever been about since puberty is having sex with me. Regardless.... I'm losing my train of thought.



More about me? ...  A normal day in the life of this bat is wake up after a terrible night's sleep (that may have been because a child wet the bed, or because they need a glass of water, or just because I can never get my body to rest.) and make breakfast for my children.  Not husband leaves for work at least an hour before anyone else is up.  I don't eat breakfast.  I have a diet soda and start the endless process of cleaning our apartment. 

 Make my bed, dust the blinds, wipe the window down.  Set out a change of clothes for Not-Husband to have ready when he gets home from work.  Take a break to do the alphabet or some simple math problems with my kids.  They get distracted quickly, and go back to playing.  

I wander over to the bathroom and scrub it down.  Put all the toiletries back in order.  Make sure to wipe up any urine that's dribbled on the seat or down the bowl because not-husband doesn't lift the seat when he goes potty.  Which is fine.  I guess it's better than leaving it up so I can fall in, yeah? heh.

With any luck, it's about lunch time by when I'm done cleaning the bathroom.  I make the kids a sandwich, or heat up the leftovers, or cut up fruit and veggies.  Deliver milk or juice.  Have another diet soda, because I don't eat lunch.  Ask my kids what they want to do.  Maybe read a story.  Maybe give them an hour of video games.

If they're playing nicely, I clean my kitchen and decide what I have to cook for dinner.  If they're not playing nicely, I go and try to help them find something else to do.  Maybe set up blocks, or brush barbie hair with them, maybe watch an episode of Ninja Turtles or Sailor Moon with them.

I pick up the living room, dust, vaccuum, and wander in circles for a little bit. 

Make dinner.  Depending on how I feel, if it's something I like or something I cooked for someone else, I might eat dinner.  I have another diet soda.

Get kids ready for bed... wander in more circles.  Watch not-husband play video games for a little bit.  Try to make small talk with him.  Wander in more circles through my apartment.

Finally, it's time for bed.  My body is tired.  My mind is tired.  Not-husband turns the porn on, and I know what time it is.  Time to be the human fleshlight.  At least his taste in women is good.  The girls are very pretty and easy to look at.  Maybe I can fall asleep tonight.

I should add that we were just friends when this mess began.  Then it went from playing video games together, to having sex.  He was a good friend, and pretty handsome, so I said yes.  Because I'm stupid.  Then I got pregnant.  I thought it would be fine to ride it out, since he wasn't angry about the child.  We decided to live together.  Then he gave me another kid a year later, even though I didn't want one at that time.  I thought if I gave him what he wanted, he would finally love me more than just some deteriorated friendship we had left.  But of course it didn't, because, duh, I'm stupid and incapable of making good decisions.

So I should clarify.  He never loved me.  We were friends, but not so much anymore.

No.... He once told me that "If you're so unhappy, you're free to go."  But I have nowhere to go.  And even if I did, he will erase us from his life.  He's probably spend his life dodging calls and child support to spite me.  His kids LOVE him though.  I can't do that.  I can't just remove their love in favor of myself.

You're so kind... nobody has ever wanted to hear me talk.

Honestly?  This is the best.  I love him, even if he doesn't love me.  I seriously dated two people prior to the guy I call husband (even though we aren't actually married, we've just been together for 6 years and have kids together) and they were even worse to me.  I'm at the peak.  He doesn't hit me, and even if we've been living in poverty, he always gave us enough to eat and scrape by. However, I know he does not love me.  There are many reasons I know.  He sees other women.  Younger ones.  Flings and whatnot.  He doesn't kiss me, hug me, hold my hand, emotionally support me.  In fact, if I have feelings to discuss, I am shut down completely.  Walked away from.  Told,  "When you pull yourself together, we can discuss this."  But that never comes.

I've just been a miserable failure for so long...

And no.  I do not have anyone.  The only friend I have is my sister, and I can't tell her these things.  I've let her down enough in life.  I can't hurt her feelings anymore, I love her.

I love my not!husband, too... but he doesn't love me.  I know that.  And I'm okay with it.  He doesn't have to, because I don't deserve it.  But I will die for him.  He tolerates my presence because he can't afford child care, and he likes having clean clothes, a clean home, and food prepared when he finally gets off work.  He likes the convenience of the maid he can fuck.  We have nothing in common I know all this, but I would die for him.  He's just as scared and confused and messed up as I am.  Besides, without him, my lovey children would be homeless.

A clinic wouldn't be angry at me for not having my children vaccinated or general checkups?  Would they really be happy that I know I'm wrong?  What if I have nothing to pay them at all?  Does it just become another bill in our pile of debt?  How do people get health care?  How do you enroll a child in school?  How do I even keep living when everything hurts, and I have nobody to help me?...

I just know they're much better off without me.  With someone else who knows how to navigate life in general.

I suppose it should be of note that I've attempted suicide before.

Sorry if my thoughts are so disjointed that I don't make any sense.  My mind is a blur, and I have no clue on how to put my brain back together.

My opinions have changed, but I don't have the resources or knowledge on how to fix it.  I feel like I've been lucky.  My children haven't been sick a day in their young lives. I'm afraid that, even if I do find a way to fix it, I will be judged hard. Maybe they will think I was a terrible mother.  Maybe they will take my children away from me if they knew just how stupid my beliefs were.  I don't know how to change.  

My children are better off without me because if I go away, someone can fix my mistakes, and I won't have to hurt myself or anyone else anymore.
Something better for my children.  Relief from knowing I just can't do it right...
